title: Dang's Ramayana Trail, Shabari, Pampa & Anjani

stops.note: Kund-and-cave trek; local guide from the base village

day_notes.note: A half-day of Dang's living Ramayana geography from Ahwa or en route Saputara–interior. January adds the Shabridham Mela; Ram Navami is the devotional peak. Dress modestly; the Anjan Kund leg needs walking shoes.

notes: Treat the sites as living devotional geography, cherished traditions, told honestly. Combine with Girmal Falls for a full interior day.
